reason: Removed from KEF US/UK sites (URL redirects to in-wall collection); UK retailer lists it as discontinued. No Tier A/B checked.
brand_notes: KEF US current on-wall/in-wall pages (us.kef.com/collections/in-wall) list only Ci in-wall/architectural models; no KEF US product page exists for T101/T301 (URLs 301-redirect to /collections/in-wall; uk.kef.com does the same). KEF has no current on-wall L/R model in the US lineup. T-series (T101 ultra-thin satellite, 8 ohm, 300x140x35 mm, 87 dB / 90 dB wall-mounted claim) is a legacy line; ASR Klippel measurement exists (https://www.audiosciencereview.com/forum/index.php?threads/kef-t101-review-thin-speaker.29574/; data in raw/spinorama/KEF T101/asr/; computed LW +/-4.6 dB, free-field f3 193 Hz, sens 87.7 dB, major DI discontinuity, ER dip 5.3 dB; pref -1.3 / 3.3 with sub). Useful as a reference for what free-field spinorama of a thin wall satellite looks like.
